articles.title: French protests see numbers surge as unions join strikes over high cost of living
articles.description: The interior ministry estimates 600,000 people joined protests across France, while the unions say the number was far higher.

articles.title: 'All this food is now useless': Piles of rubbish after shop freezers hit by cyber-attack
articles.description: Dozens of supermarkets in seven European countries dumped huge quantities of food after refrigerators and freezers were targeted in a cyber-attack.

articles.title: Vance walks Trump tightrope with scathing election critique blaming Iran war
articles.description: The vice-president's blunt assessment of Republican election defeat marked one of the sharpest breaks with a sitting president in recent memory.

articles.title: Russia attacks Ukrainian aid hub in one of the deadliest strikes since war began
articles.description: Russian strikes on an aid hub killed at least 40 people - making it one of Russia's deadliest attacks on Ukrainian civilians since the full-scale invasion began, officials said.
